# re:verse DS

> An AI-ready mobile banking design system in Figma (file qUknPCIey4DG3PH19e1OmD). Agents describe screens as JSON specs; a renderer builds them from the library's components and variables, following the rules and recipes below.

## Start here
- [Agent rules](AGENTS.md): hard rules and the build pipeline (Claude Code reads it via CLAUDE.md)
- [Spec format](specs/format.md): how to describe a screen or a flow
- [Persona and data](foundations/persona.md): the one person, accounts, people, transactions and numbers every screen uses
- [Figma map](state/figma.json): pages, sections, examples; [library](state/library.json): component ids, keys, properties (generated)

## Foundations
- [Layout grammar](foundations/layout.md): think first, archetypes, all spacing numbers, rows, sheet anatomy, composition checks
- [Quality bar](foundations/quality.md): what finished work satisfies — logic, copy, craft, canvas
- [Anti-patterns](foundations/anti-patterns.md): signs a screen looks assembled, not designed
- [Tokens](foundations/tokens.md): collections, which color token for which role, radius
- [Theming](foundations/theming.md): brand themes (re:verse, Atlas), light/dark, Spirit personas
- [Typography](foundations/typography.md): text styles and when to use them
- [Voice](foundations/voice.md): UI copy, Spirit tone of voice, persona voice variables

## Components
- [Catalog](components/overview.md): every component, its synonyms and the file to read
- [Properties](components/_properties.md): every property and variant value (generated from Figma)
- [Blocks](components/blocks.md): Hero amount, Action row, List group, Bottom chat, Option sheet
- [Icons](components/icons.md): which SF outline icon means what
- [Controls & feedback](components/controls.md): toggle, selection, progress, badge, alert, empty state, search…

## Recipes
- [Recipes index](recipes/overview.md): account, card, profile, settings, transactions, picker, money move, home feed, chat answer — each with a spec to start from

## Scenarios (flows)
- [Template](scenarios/_template.md); [Freeze card](scenarios/freeze-card.md) + [spec](scenarios/freeze-card.json); [Split bill](scenarios/split-bill.md)

## Skills and critics
- [build-screen](.agents/skills/build-screen/SKILL.md), [build-flow](.agents/skills/build-flow/SKILL.md), [audit-screen](.agents/skills/audit-screen/SKILL.md), [sync-library](.agents/skills/sync-library/SKILL.md), [ds-doctor](.agents/skills/ds-doctor/SKILL.md), [report-friction](.agents/skills/report-friction/SKILL.md), [run-evals](.agents/skills/run-evals/SKILL.md)
- Critics: [screen-critic](agents/screen-critic.md), [flow-reviewer](agents/flow-reviewer.md), [domain-critic](agents/domain-critic.md), [rules-critic](agents/rules-critic.md)

## Tools
- `scripts/lint-spec.mjs`, `scripts/build-call.mjs`, `scripts/figma/render.js` — spec → Figma
- `scripts/figma/audit-screen.js`, `scripts/figma/audit-flow.js` — checks in Figma
- `scripts/figma/dump-library.js`, `scripts/merge-library.mjs`, `scripts/check-docs.mjs`, `scripts/sync-agents.mjs` — keep docs and Figma in sync
- [Figma Plugin API gotchas](docs/figma-api.md)
